correctness.rationale: Exact even/odd deck-image minimization gives a lift-invariant cyclic sign. The antiperiodic Fourier diagonalization and Hilbert–Schmidt trace give c_n. Independent vertical moments are E[u^2]=b^4/(360a^4), with zero distinct-edge covariance. Single-edge second derivative is -4c_(n-2), and the three-edge forest band bound controls the O_n((b/a)^6) remainder. Checked code corroborates nearest images, trace coefficients, derivative and samples; it does not replace proof.
